disagreement: missing requirement: that Benefits Enrollment no longer links to an Infrastructure Team criterion, as its own requirement; one pass has it, the other carries that check only through the Benefits Enrollment change; kept because the request asks for it in its own clause (resolved on that requirement).

disagreement: disposition: Both services use that exact criteria: one pass repaired it (the services must use the new criterion 4), the other kept it while testing the same criterion 4; chose repaired, since the query as written accepts the Infrastructure Team criterion, which the request removes.
The passes otherwise agree on every id and cell; their texts and assumptions differ in wording only.
hr_service holds one hr_criteria per service, so pointing Payroll Support at the visibility criterion replaces its service-level link to the approval criterion 2. The request asks both that only compensation specialists and admins see payroll cases and that approval routing still works; the benchmark resolves this in favour of visibility, which this file follows while keeping criterion 2 itself active. Approval routing on existing cases lives in hr_case.approval_criteria and approver, which no listed tool writes, and is not tested.
The limit on managers (status-only views of their direct reports) cannot be expressed in this schema: permission and role_permission grant access per resource with no field or reporting-line scope, and no listed tool writes roles or permissions, so it is not tested.
The members of the new group (compensation specialists and HR platform admins) and the new criterion's users list are not tested: the request names no people, and no listed tool writes user_group_member. The new group's and criterion's org_id is not tested: the request does not fix it, though the services and the acting user belong to organisation 1.
The request asks to use the existing access objects, but none represents the compensation owners, so a new group and criterion are required, as the benchmark expects. Performance Review and Policy Questions (services 4 and 5, org 2) use HR Team Visibility and are outside the request.
